lessons.title: 2D Game Engines: Kaplay & Phaser
lessons.summary: Compare two powerful browser-based 2D engines. See the same feature written in both. Learn when to use an engine versus coding from scratch — and what scenes, sprites, tilemaps, and tweens are.

lessons.title: Tool Rosetta: One Idea, Every Engine & 3D App
lessons.summary: Our game and 3D lessons teach ideas, not brands. Pick the engines and 3D apps you use and the Rosetta translates each idea, from delta time to extrude, into every one of them.

lessons.title: Rosetta 2D: Our Own Game Engine
lessons.summary: Meet the class's own lightweight 2D game engine. Play two example games, see their hitboxes and their levels as data, export a map to Tiled, and learn the engine ideas that transfer to Godot, Unity, Unreal, GameMaker and Phaser.

lessons.title: 3D Motion
lessons.summary: Track position, velocity, and acceleration in three dimensions — from a thrown ball to a spacecraft trajectory

lessons.title: 3D Printing — Settings, Rules & Perfect Prints
lessons.summary: Master layer height, infill, supports, bed adhesion, temperature, and speed with an interactive slicer settings simulator

lessons.title: ASCII: Text That Became Games
lessons.summary: Decode letters into binary, shade 3D shapes with characters, and play a tiny Rogue. Cross-referenced with ASCII City, Crawlspace, and Retro Dungeon Quest.

lessons.title: The Demoscene
lessons.summary: Discover the community that makes real-time computer art in tiny programs, then run classic demo effects (plasma, starfield, tunnel, fire, sine scroller) and see how few bytes each needs.

lessons.title: Nam June Paik
lessons.summary: See how Nam June Paik played the television like an instrument — Magnet TV, TV Buddha, a 1,003-screen tower — then bend a TV picture with a virtual magnet.

lessons.title: Print-in-Place Fidgets — The Spiral Cone
lessons.summary: Design 3D-printed fidgets that come off the bed already moving: measure your printer's real clearance, build a captured spinner, then model the spiral cone fidget from scratch — with a full path in both Blender and Tinkercad.

lessons.title: A* Pathfinding Agent
lessons.summary: Navigate grid worlds with optimal graph search — the algorithm behind GPS, games, and robotics

lessons.title: AC vs. DC Electricity
lessons.summary: Compare alternating and direct current with an interactive waveform lab, transmission-loss calculator, modern grid examples, safety guidance, and quiz

lessons.title: Acts: Jerusalem to the Nations
lessons.summary: Trace Spirit-empowered witness from Jerusalem through Judea and Samaria toward the nations.

lessons.title: Ada Lovelace — The First Programmer
lessons.summary: Explore the life and legacy of Ada Lovelace — the world's first computer programmer. Learn how she envisioned algorithms, loops, and general-purpose computing a century before the first computer was built.

lessons.title: Before Computers: Myths, Logic, and AI Imagination
lessons.summary: Talos, Golem stories, Aristotle's logic, the Mechanical Turk, HAL 9000, and Asimov's I, Robot

lessons.title: AI Origins: ELIZA Chatbot
lessons.summary: Build a classic pattern-matching therapist bot — the 1966 program that fooled people into thinking they were talking to a human

lessons.title: Albert Einstein
lessons.summary: Investigate Einstein’s life and four 1905 breakthroughs with an accurate moving light-clock experiment, a photoelectric-effect lab, curved-spacetime evidence, and mass-energy calculations

lessons.title: Amino Acids & Proteins
lessons.summary: Explore proteinogenic amino acids, peptide bonds, categories, properties, and how protein structure drives biological function

lessons.title: How America Got to the Moon
lessons.summary: The Apollo 11 mission, orbital mechanics, Newton's laws, hand calculations, guidance computers, and the engineering path to the Moon

lessons.title: Archimedes' Principle
lessons.summary: Discover why ships float and rocks sink — explore density, buoyancy, and the Sink or Float Machine

lessons.title: Arduino Board Anatomy Lab
lessons.summary: Explore the UNO R3, Nano Every, UNO R4 WiFi, and UNO Q by selecting pins, chips, connectors, LEDs, and printed terms, then trace how signals reach each board's computing brain

lessons.title: Arduino Programming: Variables, Functions & Libraries
lessons.summary: Store readings in variables, map an analog sensor to a PWM output, write a custom function with parameters, and pull in a library instead of reinventing the wheel

lessons.title: Arduino: The Robot Brain
lessons.summary: Set up the Arduino IDE, blink an LED and read the Serial Monitor, understand setup() vs loop(), send a Morse-code message, and compare a microcontroller to a neuron

lessons.title: Area & Perimeter Playground
lessons.summary: Build shapes on a clickable grid to see area and perimeter update live, then compare shapes that share a perimeter but not an area

lessons.title: Arecibo Message
lessons.summary: Decode the 1974 binary transmission broadcast toward the M13 star cluster — humanity's first deliberate message to the stars

lessons.title: The Asteroid Belt
lessons.summary: Explore the rocky region between Mars and Jupiter — Ceres, Vesta, Kirkwood gaps, meteorites, and why Jupiter kept the belt from becoming a planet

lessons.title: Analog Mixer Lab: Patch, Gain & FX Bus
lessons.summary: Patch a 12-channel mixer by hand, choose the right cable for every mic, instrument, and speaker, trace signal from preamp to fader, and route AUX sends into a reverb/delay FX bus.

lessons.title: Axolotls & Neoteny
lessons.summary: Explore how axolotls keep juvenile traits into adulthood, stay aquatic, regenerate complex tissues, and model a curious beginner's mind

lessons.title: The Baloney Detection Kit
lessons.summary: Apply Carl Sagan's seven-tool critical thinking framework to astrology, conspiracy thinking, and false faith healing — and contrast them with the rigorously witnessed miracles of Jesus

lessons.title: Bandsaw Design Lab — Cuts, Curves & Creative Inventions
lessons.summary: Learn to operate a bandsaw safely, master blade selection and relief cuts, then create fish, animals, characters, and imaginary creatures from wood using the full creative power of the bandsaw.

lessons.title: Ludwig van Beethoven
lessons.summary: Trace how Beethoven kept composing after total hearing loss, using bone conduction to feel vibration through the piano — and how the Ninth Symphony followed.

lessons.title: Johann Sebastian Bach
lessons.summary: Read and play Bach’s Invention No. 8 in a live score, see how a canon copies a melody in time and pitch, and hear public-domain Bach recordings.

lessons.title: Antonio Vivaldi
lessons.summary: Play the opening of “Spring” from The Four Seasons, learn how program music paints scenes, and hear public-domain recordings of all four seasons.

lessons.title: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
lessons.summary: Play Eine kleine Nachtmusik and the Rondo alla turca in a live score, hear how Classical phrases ask and answer, and explore Mozart’s life.

lessons.title: Frédéric Chopin
lessons.summary: Play Chopin’s complete Prelude in A major, learn about rubato and the piano’s sustain pedal, and hear Rachmaninoff play Chopin.

lessons.title: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
lessons.summary: Play a melody from Album for the Young, discover the secret celesta in The Nutcracker, and compare instrument timbres in a live score.

lessons.title: Scott Joplin
lessons.summary: Play The Entertainer in a live score, learn to count ragtime syncopation, and hear Scott Joplin’s own 1916 piano-roll recording.

lessons.title: Benjamin Franklin
lessons.summary: Follow the kite experiment that proved lightning is electricity, then trace it to the lightning rod and the positive/negative charge convention still used in physics today.

lessons.title: Bible Foundations & Pathway
lessons.summary: Explore a visible six-stage Bible pathway with fourteen built lesson foundations (including Elijah) plus six more in development (Genesis, the Flood, Exodus, the Johns of the Bible, Job, and Ecclesiastes), each with Scripture anchors, essential questions, learning goals, and interactive teaching designs.

lessons.title: Biomechanics: The Physics of Sports
lessons.summary: Apply kinematics, projectile motion, torque, conserved angular momentum, impulse, and elastic energy to real sports — free throws, javelin, figure-skating spins, and landings — with two interactive simulators.

lessons.title: Biomimicry: Engineering Nature's Genius
lessons.summary: Study how engineers observe, abstract, and emulate nature designs like burdock burrs and kingfisher beaks, then match real inventions to their biological inspiration in an interactive lab.

lessons.title: Character Modeling
lessons.summary: Box-model a simple stylized character with clean all-quad topology at every joint, smoothed with a Subdivision Surface modifier.

lessons.title: Compositing
lessons.summary: Grade and finish a rendered image with a compositor node graph — Render Layers, the Viewer node, Glare, and Color Balance.

lessons.title: Environments & Modular Kits
lessons.summary: Build reusable wall, floor, and doorway pieces on a grid, snap them into a room with your window and chair, and light the scene.

lessons.title: Furniture Design
lessons.summary: Box-model a chair at true dimensions, using the Mirror modifier for guaranteed symmetry and Bevel for believable shading.

lessons.title: Geometry Nodes
lessons.summary: Read a Geometry Nodes graph, expose modifier inputs, understand fields, and build a randomized instance scatter.

lessons.title: Blender Interface & Navigation
lessons.summary: Read the four main editor areas, orbit and pan the viewport, add and transform objects with shortcuts, and build a tiny lit scene.

lessons.title: Materials, Lighting & Render
lessons.summary: Unwrap UVs, build a Principled BSDF material, light a scene with a key and fill light, and render a finished image.

lessons.title: 3D Design Studio Pathway
lessons.summary: Survey the major kinds of 3D design software, then practice transferable modeling, sculpting, materials, lighting, and export ideas through a hands-on Blender studio.

lessons.title: Props & Hand Tools
lessons.summary: Model a hammer or wrench with round and hex Boolean cuts, then fix hard-surface shading with the Weighted Normal modifier.

lessons.title: Sculpting
lessons.summary: Block in an organic form with sculpt brushes, toggle Dynamic Topology, clean up with Voxel Remesh, and protect finished areas with masks.

lessons.title: Windows & Doors
lessons.summary: Cut a real opening through a wall with the Boolean modifier, then build a framed, beveled, paned window around it.

lessons.title: 3D Workflow Workspaces
lessons.summary: Map the shared stages of 3D work — modeling, sculpting, UVs, shading, animation, rendering, compositing, and procedural design — through Blender's workspace tabs.

lessons.title: Blocks World Parser
lessons.summary: Parse commands and act in a toy world model — a cornerstone of 1970s symbolic AI research

lessons.title: Breadboard Basics
lessons.summary: No solder required — learn how breadboards work and build a working LED circuit step by step

lessons.title: Bridge Over Troubled Water
lessons.summary: Design a bridge that can carry an ambulance by balancing material, structure, span, supports, and safety factor

lessons.title: Bug Bots: Genghis & the Insect Robots
lessons.summary: How MIT's six-legged robot Genghis walked without a central brain using subsumption architecture — and how you can build the same physics with a toothbrush and a vibrating motor.

lessons.title: Build Your Student Page
lessons.summary: Build the page you'll publish on this very site — in a live editor with instant preview. Structure it in HTML, style it with real color theory, add one interactive element in JavaScript, and watch the checklists grade themselves.

lessons.title: Camera Controls in 3D CAD
lessons.summary: Learn orbit, pan, zoom, home view, the orientation cube, and axis awareness — modeled on Tinkercad and Fusion 360

lessons.title: Life Invented the Animal
lessons.summary: Life Sciences Lesson — The Cambrian Explosion: 541 million years ago, nearly every animal body plan appeared in a geological eyeblink. Meet trilobites, Anomalocaris, and Hallucigenia — then design your own Cambrian creature.

lessons.title: Catalysts & Activation Energy
lessons.summary: A catalyst speeds up a reaction without being consumed — how lowering the activation energy barrier changes the rate

lessons.title: Dalton and the Atomic Theory
lessons.summary: Use John Dalton's particle model to explain whole-number ratios, the law of multiple proportions, and why scientific models change with evidence.

lessons.title: Cathode Ray Tube
lessons.summary: Fire electrons through a vacuum and steer them with electric and magnetic fields — the technology inside oscilloscopes and old televisions

lessons.title: CGI Water: From Physics to Pixels
lessons.summary: Discover how movies simulate water using Navier-Stokes equations, SPH particles, Gerstner ocean waves, and the optics of reflection and refraction.

lessons.title: AI Chess Through History
lessons.summary: Play one lesson with multiple historical chess AI models — from Turochamp to modern engines

lessons.title: Chess: Origins and How to Play
lessons.summary: Trace chess from chaturanga to the modern game, then practice board setup, piece movement, captures, check, and checkmate

lessons.title: Climate Modeling Simulator
lessons.summary: Tune CO₂, solar output, ice coverage, deforestation, and methane on a live 3D Earth — watch weather systems respond in real time

lessons.title: Clocks & Telling Time
lessons.summary: Measure time from sundials to atomic clocks while connecting cycles, units, navigation, and relativity

lessons.title: Color Theory Lab
lessons.summary: Explore hue, saturation, value, warm and cool palettes, and harmony schemes with a live palette builder

lessons.title: Completing the Square
lessons.summary: Turn quadratics into perfect squares with a visual square model, worked example, and interactive practice

lessons.title: Conservation of Energy
lessons.summary: Energy is the universe's bookkeeping invariant — a number that never changes. Explore kinetic energy, potential energy, work, power, conservative vs. nonconservative forces, and the law that makes nature's books always balance.

lessons.title: Conservation of Momentum
lessons.summary: Every collision, explosion, and rocket burn obeys one law: total momentum never changes in an isolated system. Explore elastic and inelastic collisions, impulse, the center of mass, and how this law survives into relativity.

lessons.title: Constellations
lessons.summary: Explore 16 constellations with an interactive star map — when each was named, when its stars and deep-sky objects were discovered, what their spectra reveal about elemental composition, plus the zodiac, magnitude, navigation, and links to related lessons

lessons.title: Coulomb's Law
lessons.summary: The electric version of gravity — opposite charges attract, like charges repel, with an inverse-square law

lessons.title: Connectomics: Mapping the Brain
lessons.summary: Explore the field of Connectomics, mapping the brain's wiring diagram, and simulate how neural circuits produce behavior.

lessons.title: CRISPR & Synthetic Biology Lab
lessons.summary: Explore guide RNA recognition, compare DNA repair outcomes, and test a fictional fluorescent reporter circuit against an unedited control.

lessons.title: Cryptography & The Enigma
lessons.summary: Explore Caesar ciphers, the Enigma machine, Bletchley Park codebreaking, and modern RSA-style public key exchange

lessons.title: Cryptozoology: From Footprints to Facts
lessons.summary: Explore a map-filtered global Cryptidex of reported animals, folklore, yōkai, creepypasta, and viral fiction; rank evidence, classify case files, and design an ethical field expedition

lessons.title: Cymatics: The Geometry of Sound
lessons.summary: Make invisible resonant modes visible with sand, water, and slime while connecting nodes and antinodes to instruments, rooms, and audio systems.

lessons.title: Dadaism
lessons.summary: See how WWI-era artists broke every rule of composition on purpose — readymades, photomontage, and sound poetry — then generate a poem by pure chance

lessons.title: Digital Signal Processing
lessons.summary: Decompose sound into sine waves, build audio filters, and visualize how digital systems isolate, amplify, and reconstruct signals

lessons.title: Newton's Dispersive Prism
lessons.summary: In 1666 Newton proved white light is a mixture of all visible colours — explore dispersion, Snell's Law, and spectrum

lessons.title: DNA & Heredity
lessons.summary: From the double helix to Punnett squares — how traits are encoded, copied, and passed from parent to offspring

lessons.title: Do Atoms Make Music?
lessons.summary: Connect music, sound, heat, light, electricity, radio waves, molecules, and atoms through oscillation, vibration, frequency, and resonance

lessons.title: Measuring the Earth
lessons.summary: How Eratosthenes calculated Earth's circumference in 240 BC with a stick and a shadow

lessons.title: Electron Microscopes
lessons.summary: Use accelerated electrons as tiny waves to resolve viruses, cell structures, nanomaterials, and atoms — compare SEM and TEM imaging

lessons.title: Electronic Components
lessons.summary: A practical field guide to identifying resistors, LEDs, capacitors, diodes, transistors, and buttons, with polarity and placement on a breadboard

lessons.title: Electronic Materials Lab
lessons.summary: Test real materials in an interactive circuit to compare conductors, insulators, and semiconductors, then learn the vocabulary electronics builders use on the bench

lessons.title: Electronic Schematics
lessons.summary: Read circuit diagrams like an engineer: match real parts to symbols, drill the symbol library, judge junctions and net labels, step through a transistor switch, probe test points to find a fault, then build four useful circuits

lessons.title: Elijah: Prophet of the Living God
lessons.summary: Follow Elijah's confrontations with Ahab and Baal worship from Cherith and Zarephath through Mount Carmel to the still small voice at Horeb.

lessons.title: Daniel: Faithfulness in Exile
lessons.summary: Explore all twelve chapters of Daniel, compare faithful choices under pressure, and read kingdom visions with passage evidence.

lessons.title: Emily Roebling
lessons.summary: Meet the engineer who led construction of the Brooklyn Bridge after her husband fell ill, teaching herself catenary math, caisson pressure, and cable construction along the way.

lessons.title: Engineering Design Process Studio
lessons.summary: A capstone lesson: walk the Define, Model, Prototype, Test, and Iterate design loop against a real constraint-driven rescue-drone brief, and defend the tradeoffs behind your final design

lessons.title: Entomology: The Science of Insects
lessons.summary: Investigate insect anatomy, trace the history of entomology from Swammerdam to Fabre, explore metamorphosis, and classify real mystery-bug photographs with observable evidence

lessons.title: Entropy
lessons.summary: Explore why mixed states are more probable than ordered ones. Connect microstates, heat flow, information, and the Second Law in an interactive particle lab.

lessons.title: EQ: Find the Problem Frequency
lessons.summary: Recognize rumble, mud, boxiness, nasal tone, and harshness; sweep a parametric EQ; and make evidence-based corrective cuts.

lessons.title: Ethical Hacking & Cyber Safety
lessons.summary: Think like an ethical hacker through age-appropriate permission, cipher, phishing, and password-strength missions

lessons.title: Event Horizon Telescope
lessons.summary: Build the synchronized global array behind the 2019 M87* and 2022 Sagittarius A* black hole images

lessons.title: From Rocket Clubs to STEAM
lessons.summary: Trace modern STEAM from 1950s youth rocketry and Sputnik-era school reform through the STEM acronym and the addition of arts and design

lessons.title: The Evolution of Wood
lessons.summary: Trace lignin's evolution from a water-transport upgrade in small Devonian plants to the first forests, then the 100-million-year gap before fungi could rot wood that created Earth's coal beds

lessons.title: Rule Engine Expert System
lessons.summary: Create if-then inference with confidence scores — how 1980s expert systems encoded human knowledge

lessons.title: The Falling Coil
lessons.summary: Drop a coil through a magnetic field and watch motion become electricity — Lenz's law in action

lessons.title: Faraday Cage
lessons.summary: See why a hollow conductor shields its interior — electromagnetic shielding in elevators, cars, and everyday life

lessons.title: Faraday's Law
lessons.summary: Change the magnetic field through a loop and voltage appears — the foundation of every generator and motor

lessons.title: The Feasts of Israel
lessons.summary: Explore Israel's sacred calendar, harvest rhythms, remembrance, worship, and communal identity.

lessons.title: Atoms: Structure, Motion & Matter
lessons.summary: Explore atomic structure, particle motion, temperature, pressure, electron clouds, and how atoms connect to the periodic table

lessons.title: Fibonacci Sequence
lessons.summary: Build the famous recursive number pattern and connect it to growth, ratios, spirals, and the golden ratio

lessons.title: Fossil Fuels: How Coal, Oil & Natural Gas Form
lessons.summary: Compare how coal forms from buried land plants versus how oil and natural gas form from buried marine plankton, tracing coalification and the kerogen oil/gas windows

lessons.title: Fourier Series & Transform
lessons.summary: Stack epicycles to build a square wave, hear each harmonic arrive, draw a wave and read back its recipe, magnify the Gibbs overshoot, analyse live sound on a spectrogram, and compress an image the way JPEG does

lessons.title: From Scratch: Build a Browser Game
lessons.summary: Write a real dodge game with zero libraries. Learn the update/render loop, canvas drawing, keyboard input, and AABB collision detection — then play your creation directly in the browser.

lessons.title: Fundamental Forces
lessons.summary: Only four fundamental forces govern everything in the universe. Explore gravity, electromagnetism, the weak force, and the strong force — plus friction, molecular forces, and the fictitious pseudo forces of rotating reference frames.

lessons.title: Character Animation
lessons.summary: Animate a character idle and walk cycle with strong poses, clean foot contact, seamless loops, named actions, and reliable Godot import.

lessons.title: Character Rigging
lessons.summary: Build a simple character armature, parent and weight the mesh, repair influence problems, and complete a deformation stress test.

lessons.title: Furniture Prop Lab
lessons.summary: Model measured 3D furniture with a readable silhouette, efficient geometry, clean shading, useful origin, and simple engine collision.

lessons.title: Modular Room Builder
lessons.summary: Build reusable wall, floor, doorway, ceiling, and corner modules and assemble multiple playable rooms on a dependable grid.

lessons.title: Game Asset Studio
lessons.summary: Create textures, furniture, modular rooms, optimized GLB assets, a rigged character, and reusable animations in a six-lesson Blender-to-Godot pathway.

lessons.title: Texture Workshop
lessons.summary: Read real surfaces, create a seamless PBR material, and test texture scale and response under game lighting.

lessons.title: UV, Materials & Export
lessons.summary: Unwrap and pack UVs, build portable PBR materials, export glTF binary assets, and validate them in Godot.

lessons.title: What Makes a Game?
lessons.summary: Break any game into Mechanics, Dynamics, and Aesthetics. Explore game genres, identify the 4 core elements of every game, and use the MDA framework to design your own concept — no code required.

lessons.title: Game Jam Week: From Idea to Demo
lessons.summary: The complete Game Jam playbook. Write a Game Design Document, use the scope checker to plan a build you can actually finish, follow a day-by-day sprint, and demo your game on showcase day.

lessons.title: GitHub — From Idea to Shared Prototype
lessons.summary: Practice commits, branches, pull-request review, prototype planning, and safe website publishing with GitHub Pages

lessons.title: Deep Blue to AlphaGo: The Go Challenge
lessons.summary: Play 9×9 Go against a Monte Carlo AI, then see why AlphaGo needed learned priors instead of brute-force depth

lessons.title: Animation & Game Feel
lessons.summary: Make game events readable and satisfying with motion, sound, particles, lighting changes, and camera feedback.

lessons.title: Godot Basics: Your First 3D Room
lessons.summary: Navigate the Godot editor, build your first 3D room with a camera, lighting, and collisions, then write GDScript to move a player. Learn the Node/Scene system that powers every Godot project.

lessons.title: Collectibles, Signals & UI
lessons.summary: Create reusable energy cells, connect events without tangled code, update a score display, and win the level.

lessons.title: Enemies & Simple AI
lessons.summary: Give a patrol guard detection, navigation, chase, damage, cooldown, and return behavior using clear states.

lessons.title: Export, Test & Publish
lessons.summary: Package a release build, test it without the editor, write useful bug reports, and prepare the game for players.

lessons.title: GDScript Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Store game state, make decisions, organize reusable functions, loop through data, and safely connect scripts to nodes.

lessons.title: Levels & Game State
lessons.summary: Connect mechanics into a complete loop with title, pause, retry, scene transitions, checkpoints, and persistence.

lessons.title: Godot Game Developer Pathway
lessons.summary: Build Signal Run one dependable system at a time: editor foundations, GDScript, player control, collectibles, enemy AI, game feel, game state, and release testing.

lessons.title: Player Controller & Camera
lessons.summary: Build responsive movement with acceleration, jumping, smooth turning, mouse-look, and a camera that avoids walls.

lessons.title: Grace Hopper
lessons.summary: Meet the Navy rear admiral who built the first compiler, translating English-like code into machine instructions — the idea behind every modern programming language and COBOL.

lessons.title: Margaret Hamilton: Software for the Moon
lessons.summary: Explore Hamilton’s Apollo software work, investigate the landing alarms, and compare computer workload policies in an interactive reliability lab.

lessons.title: Graphing Calculator
lessons.summary: Plot any equation in seconds — linear, quadratic, trig, and more with an interactive coordinate plane

lessons.title: The Guitar: History, Frets & Chords
lessons.summary: Trace the guitar from ancient lutes and the Baroque five-course guitar to classical, steel-string, and electric guitars, then map triads and arpeggios onto the fretboard and hear I–ii–V–I.

lessons.title: Hedy Lamarr
lessons.summary: Meet the Hollywood star who co-invented frequency-hopping spread spectrum in 1942 — a jam-resistant radio technique that decades later underpins Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GPS.

lessons.title: Heliocentrism — The Sun at the Center
lessons.summary: Aristarchus figured out the Sun-centered solar system 1,800 years before the world believed it — explore Kepler's laws and Galileo's evidence

lessons.title: Henry Ford
lessons.summary: See how the moving assembly line and interchangeable parts turned a 12-hour craft process into a repeatable manufacturing system — and reshaped how everything gets built.

lessons.title: The History of Copyright Law
lessons.summary: From early printing and the Statute of Anne to fair use, the public domain, and Woody Guthrie

lessons.title: The History of Medicine
lessons.summary: From the four humors and bloodletting to germ theory, John Snow's cholera map, and modern evidence-based care

lessons.title: Holy Week: The Final Days of Jesus
lessons.summary: Compare the Gospel accounts of Jesus' final week, death, burial, and resurrection.

lessons.title: How the Bible Reached Us
lessons.summary: Trace biblical writings through manuscript copying, canon recognition, printing, and translation.

lessons.title: Genesis 10: The Table of Nations
lessons.summary: Explore an interactive family tree of Noah's sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and see how Genesis 10 maps the ancient world and sets up the Tower of Babel and Abraham.

lessons.title: Huygens' Principle
lessons.summary: Every point on a wavefront is a new source of waves — how light bends around corners, reflects, and passes through gaps

lessons.title: Inputs: Beyond the Button
lessons.summary: Turn touch, pressure, light, motion, sound, and everyday materials into reliable, accessible physical controls, wire a pull-up resistor, and design a binary communication system with buttons and LEDs

lessons.title: The Internet of Things
lessons.summary: Trace the sensor-to-cloud IoT pipeline, build a smart home automation, choose a wireless protocol, spot insecure device defaults, and examine the monetization, social media, and AI of connected things

lessons.title: James Clerk Maxwell
lessons.summary: Explore the life and discoveries of James Clerk Maxwell — the physicist who unified electricity, magnetism, and light into four elegant equations, predicted radio waves, and took the world's first colour photograph.

lessons.title: Jesus' Parables Lab
lessons.summary: Interpret Jesus' parables through context, expectation, surprise, kingdom truth, and response.

lessons.title: Jim Henson
lessons.summary: Learn how puppetry engineered for a fixed camera frame — not a stage audience — let performers hide in plain sight and built Sesame Street and The Muppet Show.

lessons.title: Job: Suffering, Wisdom & Faithful Speech
lessons.summary: Read Job as wisdom literature: lament honestly, test easy explanations, and listen for the book's answer to suffering and human limits.

lessons.title: Katsushika Hokusai
lessons.summary: Master the art, craft, and science of Katsushika Hokusai: ukiyo-e woodblock printing, sub-millimeter kento registration, Prussian blue chemistry, and the logarithmic spiral geometry of The Great Wave.

lessons.title: Optical Illusions Lab
lessons.summary: Test more than forty optical illusions yourself, starting with the negative-color afterimage that turns a cyan, black and yellow flag red, white and blue, then checker shadows, rotating snakes, illusory triangles and a magic-eye stereogram, and learn the brain mechanism behind each.

lessons.title: Photo Editing Workshop
lessons.summary: Learn how Photoshop-style photo editors really work inside Layer Lab, an in-browser workshop: stack layers, hide with masks instead of erasing, mix with blend modes, recolor with adjustment layers, try smart selections and retouching, then move files between apps as PSD, OpenRaster, PNG and JPEG.

lessons.title: Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion
lessons.summary: Discover the three mathematical laws Kepler found by staring at Tycho's data for a decade — elliptical orbits, equal-area sweeps, and T²∝a³. Watch Newton later prove they follow inevitably from the inverse-square law of gravity.

lessons.title: Kinematics: Motion, Speed & Acceleration
lessons.summary: Describe any motion precisely before explaining why it happens. Explore position, velocity, acceleration, the kinematic equations, and the calculus connections through interactive graphs and projectile simulation.

lessons.title: Kingdoms, Prophets & Exile
lessons.summary: Synchronize Israel's kings, prophets, empires, exile, and return in one historical framework.

lessons.title: The K-Pg Extinction
lessons.summary: Trace the end-Cretaceous extinction as an ecological systems collapse: impact winter, Deccan volcanism, marine food webs, survivorship, and embedded 3D extinct species

lessons.title: The Kuiper Belt
lessons.summary: Explore the icy disk beyond Neptune — Pluto, Eris, Makemake, Haumea, orbital resonances, the scattered disk, and New Horizons' flybys of Pluto and Arrokoth

lessons.title: Language Foundations Lab
lessons.summary: Connect sounds, letters, syllables, words, sentences, speech, reading, and writing into one living symbol system

lessons.title: Japanese Language Foundations
lessons.summary: Master foundational Japanese: Hiragana, Katakana, Kanji radicals, moraic rhythm, SOV sentence structure, and essential particles

lessons.summary: Every equation worth knowing, from everyday percent and area formulas down to the Einstein field equations, organized by depth with the real jobs that use each one.

lessons.title: The Unit Factory
lessons.summary: Run a 3D conveyor and transform 10 kg weights into 28 playful unit sculptures. Compare measurement families, discover real mass conversions, and collect your findings.

lessons.title: How 𝑒 Was Discovered
lessons.summary: Rediscover Euler's number the way Bernoulli did, through compound interest, then see why e^x is its own derivative and find e in money, biology, and Euler's identity across three interactive labs.

lessons.title: The Unit Circle & Waves
lessons.summary: Drag a point around the unit circle and watch sine and cosine become waves. Learn radians and SOH-CAH-TOA, build and match waves, and preview how sine waves add up to a Fourier series.

lessons.title: Exponent Explorer
lessons.summary: Fold paper to the Moon, see why the exponent rules work, place an atom and the Sun on one ruler, meet logarithms as the exponent question, and race compound interest against simple interest.

lessons.title: Algebra Tiles: Factoring
lessons.summary: Factoring made visible: build x², x, and unit tiles into rectangles, multiply binomials with an area model, factor trinomials with the two-number rule, and see difference of squares by cutting and sliding pieces.

lessons.title: Slope of a Curve
lessons.summary: Zoom into a curve until it looks straight, watch secant lines converge on the tangent, graph the slope function, and discover the power rule: the bridge from linear slope to calculus.

lessons.title: Snap, Crackle, Pop: The Ladder of Time Derivatives
lessons.summary: Climb the ladder from position to velocity, acceleration, jerk, snap, crackle and pop. Sort the real engineering names from the jokes, tune an elevator ride by limiting jerk, and watch every derivative of circular motion turn another 90 degrees.

lessons.title: How Spread Out?
lessons.summary: Drag data points and watch range, IQR, box plots, and standard deviation respond. Compare teams with the same mean, then place values on a bell curve with the 68-95-99.7 rule and z-scores.

lessons.title: Where Lines Meet
lessons.summary: Systems of equations made visible: make two lines cross, parallel, or identical, find the break-even point between phone plans, and solve systems by elimination with a live graph to check.

lessons.title: Living Things Explorer
lessons.summary: Sort living and nonliving examples, match organisms to needs and habitats, and trace birth, growth, change, and reproduction.

lessons.title: Ecosystems & Food Webs
lessons.summary: Trace the flow of energy from producers to apex predators, then simulate how adding or removing a single species impacts the entire ecological web.

lessons.title: Alexander von Humboldt: The Father of Ecology
lessons.summary: Climb Chimborazo with the naturalist who first mapped how climate, elevation, and life connect. Invent isotherms, meet the Naturgemälde, and explore an interactive vegetation-zone diagram.

lessons.title: Natural Selection Lab
lessons.summary: Apply environmental pressures to virtual populations over many generations and watch how natural selection drives adaptation and evolutionary change.

lessons.title: LUCA: Last Universal Common Ancestor
lessons.summary: Meet LUCA, the single-celled ancestor of every living thing, check the universal traits (DNA, ribosomes, ATP) that prove it, and trace any branch of the tree of life back to its root.

lessons.title: Homeostasis & Body Systems
lessons.summary: See how the circulatory, respiratory, and nervous systems work together through feedback loops to keep the body's internal conditions stable.

lessons.title: Nutrition: A Body Systems Investigation
lessons.summary: Connect nutrient jobs to body systems, compare foods across a processing spectrum, trace human nutrition from foraging to global convenience, build a flexible plate model, and read a Nutrition Facts label without turning a classroom model into personal medical advice.

lessons.title: Immunology & the Immune System
lessons.summary: Follow the body's layered defense — barriers, innate response, and adaptive immunity — and see how vaccines train it before an infection ever arrives.

lessons.title: Life as Information
lessons.summary: Zoom out across every level of this module — DNA as code, cells as processors, ecosystems as networks — and ask what "alive" really means.

lessons.title: Anatomy of the Human Ear
lessons.summary: Outer, middle, and inner ear, the ossicles, and the cochlea — how vibration becomes a nerve signal, and the two physical paths (air and bone conduction) that can get it there.

lessons.title: Theatre Cue Sheets
lessons.summary: Write precise theatre cues and create a printable school-musical worksheet with audio, scenery, costumes, lights, props, and custom departments.

lessons.title: Stage Plotting
lessons.summary: Design a measured stage layout with draggable scenery, performers, equipment, clear routes, and custom items; print the plot and item list for a school musical.

lessons.title: Where Am I? Robot Mapping & Localization
lessons.summary: Explore occupancy grids and particle filters, then recreate mapping with ELEGOO ultrasonic sensors or paper and tape measures. Includes Arduino scanner code, a scan notebook, and classroom localization challenges.

lessons.title: Pilot the ELEGOO Robot Car
lessons.summary: Drive the class ELEGOO Smart Robot Car V4.0 from a browser over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi (or a simulator): joystick, keyboard or gamepad, live sensors and camera, mission programs, and the JSON protocol behind every command.

lessons.title: Sensor Fusion: Gyro + Accelerometer
lessons.summary: Estimate a robot’s tilt from a drifting gyroscope and a noisy accelerometer, then fuse them with a complementary filter and a Kalman filter and compare errors live.

lessons.title: Beyond A*: Motion Planning Lab
lessons.summary: Race RRT, RRT*, potential fields, and the Dynamic Window Approach on one obstacle course, then drive a differential-drive robot to see how kinematics limits every plan.

lessons.title: Reach, Grab, Place: Robot Arms
lessons.summary: Drive a three-joint robot arm by its joints or by pointing where the hand should go, stack blocks with a gripper, then explore the arm's configuration space and plan a collision-free move. Explorer, Builder, and Engineer levels.

lessons.title: Robot Reinforcement Learning: Q-Learning Lab
lessons.summary: Train a robot with Q-learning to reach its charger without falling down the stairs. Tune learning rate, patience, and curiosity, edit the world, and meet deep RL.

lessons.title: 2D Game Developer Pathway
lessons.summary: Build Pixel Courier, a pixel-art platformer, from the first pixel to a shipped game: sprites, animation, tilemaps, game loops, movement, collision, cameras, state machines, level design, and release.

lessons.title: Pixel Art & Sprites
lessons.summary: Draw a 16×16 hero with a limited palette, test its silhouette, and learn why pixel art scales with nearest-neighbour, whole-number zoom.

lessons.title: Sprite Sheets & Animation
lessons.summary: Animate a run cycle with onion skinning, pack frames into a sprite sheet, and draw frames with source rectangles and time-based frame selection.

lessons.title: Tilesets & Tilemaps
lessons.summary: Paint seamless tiles, build a level as a text grid of tile IDs, separate art from collision rules, and learn 4-bit autotiling.

lessons.title: Game Loop & Rendering
lessons.summary: Compare per-frame, delta-time and fixed-timestep updates across frame rates, and build each frame from ordered draw layers at a fixed internal resolution.

lessons.title: Movement & Jump Feel
lessons.summary: Tune acceleration, friction, gravity and jump arcs with live sliders, then add coyote time, jump buffering and variable jump height.

lessons.title: Collision & Response
lessons.summary: Step through AABB tile collisions, fix corner snagging by resolving one axis at a time, stop tunnelling with sub-steps, and build one-way platforms.

lessons.title: Cameras, Layers & Parallax
lessons.summary: Build a 2D follow camera with a dead zone, smoothing, look-ahead and level clamping, snap it to whole pixels, and layer parallax backgrounds.

lessons.title: Animation State Machines
lessons.summary: Drive idle, run, jump, fall and land animations from physics with a state machine, watch transitions live, and break it on purpose.

lessons.title: Level Design & Game Feel
lessons.summary: Design introduce–develop–twist levels, chart challenge per screen, add squash and stretch, particles, shake, hit-stop and sound, then playtest.

lessons.title: Menus, Saving & Shipping
lessons.summary: Add title, pause and win states, save a best time, credit assets, export your art, and package Pixel Courier as a standalone browser game.

lessons.title: Isaiah: Holiness, Justice & Hope
lessons.summary: Isaiah speaks into Judah’s life under Assyrian pressure. The book moves from judgment toward comfort for exiles and the hope of renewed creation.

lessons.title: Jeremiah: Courage, Covenant & Exile
lessons.summary: Jeremiah ministers in Judah’s final decades before Jerusalem’s fall to Babylon in 587/586 BCE. Warnings, conflict, grief, and promises of restoration appear together.

lessons.title: Ezekiel: God’s Presence & a People Renewed
lessons.summary: Ezekiel is a priest and prophet among Judean exiles in Babylon. His visions confront wrongdoing and announce renewal beyond Jerusalem’s destruction.

lessons.title: Lamentations: Grief, Prayer & Persistent Hope
lessons.summary: Five poems mourn Jerusalem’s destruction in 587/586 BCE. Voices shift between the ruined city, a suffering individual, and the community.

lessons.title: Division: Think in Groups
lessons.summary: See equal groups, learn why mental shortcuts work, step through long division, and practice remainders, decimals and fractions with coached feedback.

lessons.title: Multiplication: See the Structure
lessons.summary: Build arrays, discover why mental shortcuts work, connect area to written multiplication, and practice whole-number, decimal and fraction products.

lessons.title: SOH-CAH-TOA
lessons.summary: Label right-triangle sides, choose sine, cosine or tangent, and solve missing sides and angles with a live triangle and six guided challenges.

lessons.title: The Standard Model of Particle Physics
lessons.summary: Explore all 17 elementary particle types, build baryon valence cores, test interactions, and explain the evidence and limits of the Standard Model.

lessons.title: Lewis & Clark: Knowledge on the Trail
lessons.summary: Investigate the expedition through Indigenous expertise, navigation, maps, engineering failures, mercury medicine, and archaeological evidence.

lessons.title: Magellan & Elcano: A World of Water
lessons.summary: Follow the first recorded circumnavigation through ocean navigation, provisioning, local resistance, source evidence, and the missing-day mystery.

lessons.title: The Piano: History, Keys & Chords
lessons.summary: Trace the piano from plucked harpsichords to Cristofori’s soft-and-loud invention and the modern 88-key grand, then build triads, play I–ii–V–I arpeggios, and read them on the staff.

lessons.title: Gold Rush: Fortune & Fool’s Gold
lessons.summary: Compare American and Australian gold rushes, test gold versus pyrite, and investigate mining, profit, migration, and the costs to communities.

lessons.title: Origami: History, Mathematics & Library of Creations
lessons.summary: Master origami through 2,000 years of history, the Huzita-Hatori axioms that solve cubic equations, flat-foldability theorems, deployable space arrays, and an interactive step-by-step folding workbench with 8 classic creations.

lessons.title: AI Hacking: When Agents Cross the Line
lessons.summary: Investigate AI hacking reports, separate misuse from misalignment, and test layered defenses in a safe local model

lessons.title: The Wright Brothers: Learning to Fly
lessons.summary: Follow Wilbur and Orville Wright from bicycle mechanics to flight pioneers. Test wing angles, compare lift and drag, explore control, and read the first-flight photograph.

lessons.title: Land, Water & Sky: Earth's Four Spheres
lessons.summary: Explore Earth's four interconnected spheres with a layered planetary cutaway, 16-item sphere classification sorter, and cascading ecological feedback simulator.

lessons.title: Continents, Oceans & Map Projections
lessons.summary: Compare scientific map projections on a live vector globe and flat transforms, question cartographic distortions, and locate the world's continents and oceans.

lessons.title: Rocks & Soil: From Bedrock to Living Earth
lessons.summary: Simulate physical and chemical bedrock weathering, explore the 6 soil horizons, classify soil on the USDA texture triangle, simulate Stokes' Law settling, and run tactile feel tests.

lessons.title: Sun, Moon & Stars: The Celestial Clock
lessons.summary: Simulate Earth's 24-hour spin and gnomon shadows, scrub through the 29.5-day synchronized Moon phase orbit, examine solar and lunar eclipses, and track circumpolar star trails around Polaris.

lessons.title: Genesis: Creation, Promise & Family
lessons.summary: Read Genesis as one connected story of creation, fall, flood, promise, and family carried toward Egypt.

lessons.title: Exodus: Rescue, Covenant & Presence
lessons.summary: Follow Israel from slavery in Egypt through Passover, the sea, and Sinai into a covenant people.

lessons.title: Jesus’ Ministry: The Kingdom Arrives
lessons.summary: Trace Jesus’ baptism, temptation, calling, signs, conflicts, and announcement of God’s kingdom before Holy Week.

lessons.title: Joshua to David: Land, Judges & Kings
lessons.summary: Bridge the story from Joshua’s settlement through Judges, Samuel, Saul, David, and the covenant hope of a king.

lessons.title: The Epistles: Gospel Communities in Practice
lessons.summary: Read New Testament letters as situated teaching for real congregations facing identity, unity, worship, justice, and hope.

lessons.title: Psalms: Learning to Pray the Whole Life
lessons.summary: Read praise, lament, thanksgiving, wisdom, and protest as truthful speech before God.

lessons.title: Revelation: Witness, Worship & New Creation
lessons.summary: Learn to read Revelation’s symbols, letters, heavenly worship, judgment, and new creation with patience and humility.

lessons.title: Weather Watch: The Living Atmosphere
lessons.summary: Live worldwide weather cockpit, safe driving physics and hydroplaning simulator, wardrobe layering guide, air mass collision lab, and winter precipitation soundings.

lessons.title: Electrochemistry: When Reactions Push Electrons
lessons.summary: Follow electrons through a zinc-copper cell, calculate ideal cell voltage, and connect oxidation-reduction to batteries and circuits.

lessons.title: Lavoisier and the Conservation of Mass
lessons.summary: Investigate how Antoine Lavoisier used careful measurements to explain combustion and establish conservation of mass in chemical reactions.

lessons.title: Mendeleev and the Periodic Law
lessons.summary: Reconstruct Dmitri Mendeleev's periodic law, leave a predictive gap, and trace how atomic number refined the table without erasing its pattern.

lessons.title: States of Matter: Motion Makes the Difference
lessons.summary: Use a particle model to explain solids, liquids, gases, phase changes, spacing, and the role of thermal energy.

lessons.title: Stoichiometry: Counting by the Equation
lessons.summary: Treat a balanced equation as a particle recipe, calculate mole ratios, identify the limiting reactant, and distinguish predicted from actual yield.
